$comment: Deployment environments and the secret / non-secret split (backend ADR-0020), read by scripts/env/app-env.mjs and CI. The site is a static export: every NEXT_PUBLIC_* value is compiled into the bundle and is public by nature, so it lives in the committed .env.<env>.public. Secrets (patterns below) must never be NEXT_PUBLIC_*; any build-time secret goes in the git-ignored .env.<env> (CI/CD writes it from GitHub environment secrets).
